mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS < 0.5 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market weakness, indicated by the unemployment rate exceeding 8.0%, signals an elevated risk of economic slowdown and corporate earnings deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC for UNRATE > 8.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0%, the market interprets this as a coordinated monetary easing response to a weak labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with weak labor market
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 8.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (defined by FEDFUNDS > 0.5%), elevated year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.0% signals persistent price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to raise rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 0.5, or the Rank IC for the condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts, as measured by the HOUST series, signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC for HOUST is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC for INDPRO < 95.0 is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint strength in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong labor market regime (PAYEMS > 135,000 and UNRATE < 4.0), robust employment growth and low unemployment signal sustainable economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000 and UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
